cohort: A sample of 6,872,588 delivery records from California, Florida, Kentucky, Maryland, and New York from 2007 to 2014 from the State Inpatient Databases, Healthcare Cost and Utilization Project.
finding: Black women were more likely to die in-hospital, have a longer average length of stay, and undergo a cesarean delivery compared to White women, disparities that persisted across most insurance payers and socioeconomic strata.
